name: TextBox 3
text: This project screens manipulated faces and misleading news text.
textPreview: This project screens manipulated faces and misleading news text.

name: TextBox 4
text: It combines two lightweight models in one practical application.
textPreview: It combines two lightweight models in one practical application.

name: TextBox 5
text: EfficientNet-B0 classifies images; TF-IDF with logistic regression
textPreview: EfficientNet-B0 classifies images; TF-IDF with logistic regression

name: TextBox 6
text: classifies news patterns through Flask, web and Android clients.
textPreview: classifies news patterns through Flask, web and Android clients.

name: TextBox 7
text: The image model achieved 80.41% held-out balanced accuracy.

name: TextBox 8
text: Cross-source news testing revealed substantial dataset shift.

name: TextBox 3
text: Deepfakes and misinformation reduce trust in digital content.
textPreview: Deepfakes and misinformation reduce trust in digital content.

name: TextBox 4
text: Images require spatial evidence; news requires language patterns.
textPreview: Images require spatial evidence; news requires language patterns.

name: TextBox 5
text: Existing tools often treat these related problems separately.
textPreview: Existing tools often treat these related problems separately.

name: TextBox 6
text: They may also become overconfident on unfamiliar data sources.
textPreview: They may also become overconfident on unfamiliar data sources.

name: TextBox 7
text: This project unifies both detection paths behind Flask APIs,
textPreview: This project unifies both detection paths behind Flask APIs,

name: TextBox 8

text: PROBLEM STATEMENT
textPreview: PROBLEM STATEMENT

name: TextBox 3
text: • Deepfake images and deceptive news are usually checked by separate tools.
textPreview: • Deepfake images and deceptive news are usually checked by separate tools.

name: TextBox 4
text: Image-only systems may fail on new generators, compression, and weak faces.
textPreview: Image-only systems may fail on new generators, compression, and weak faces.

name: TextBox 5
text: Text-only classifiers learn source language but cannot verify factual claims.
textPreview: Text-only classifiers learn source language but cannot verify factual claims.

name: TextBox 6
text: Overconfident binary outputs can mislead users when evidence is uncertain.
textPreview: Overconfident binary outputs can mislead users when evidence is uncertain.

name: TextBox 7
text: There is a need for:
textPreview: There is a need for:

name: TextBox 8
text: • A unified image-and-text screening application.
textPreview: • A unified image-and-text screening application.

name: TextBox 9
text: • Calibrated predictions with an explicit manual-review state.
textPreview: • Calibrated predictions with an explicit manual-review state.

name: TextBox 3
text: • From existing research, we identified:
textPreview: • From existing research, we identified:

name: TextBox 4
text: • Few practical systems combine deepfake-image and news-text screening.
textPreview: • Few practical systems combine deepfake-image and news-text screening.

name: TextBox 5
text: • Cross-source evaluation is often weaker than random-split evaluation.
textPreview: • Cross-source evaluation is often weaker than random-split evaluation.

name: TextBox 6
text: • Binary decisions rarely expose low-confidence or ambiguous samples.
textPreview: • Binary decisions rarely expose low-confidence or ambiguous samples.

name: TextBox 7
text: • Content-only news models cannot retrieve evidence or establish truth.
textPreview: • Content-only news models cannot retrieve evidence or establish truth.
